Shri Krishna AYUSH University (SKAU), Kurukshetra, has officially updated the recruitment schedule for its 2026 non-teaching and para-medical positions. Candidates interested in applying for the advertised roles now have until November 2, 2026, to complete their online submissions.

The recruitment drive encompasses a total of 10 vacancies distributed across eight distinct designations, including Assistant Registrar, Sub Divisional Engineer (Civil), Junior Engineer (Civil and Electrical), Library Assistant, Library Counter Clerk, Library Restorer, and Store Keeper.

Key Dates and Application Process

The online application window commenced on October 5, 2026. Following the latest extension, the final deadline for online registration, form submission, and fee payment is set for November 2, 2026, up to 04:00 PM.

Applicants must note that the submission process requires an additional step: candidates are required to download their completed application form, sign every page, and upload the scanned signed copy. The official guidelines specify that failure to upload the signed application form alongside fee deposition will render the candidature invalid.

Eligibility and Age Criteria

Prospective candidates must fall within the age bracket of 18 to 42 years as of the designated closing date. Age relaxations are applicable according to the prevailing guidelines issued by the Government of Haryana. Educational requirements vary strictly by post, ranging from specialized diplomas in engineering for junior engineering roles to Master's degrees and specific administrative or library science qualifications for higher-level administrative positions.

Furthermore, applicants must satisfy specific linguistic requirements—such as having studied Hindi or Sanskrit as a subject in Matriculation or higher education—and possess requisite computer literacy certificates where mandated by the service rules.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For applicants preparing their documentation, ensuring compliance with category-specific requirements—such as valid Haryana Domicile, caste certificates, or Economically Weaker Section (EWS) documents for the 2026–27 cycle—is crucial before final submission.

Confirmed Facts vs. Unknowns

  • Confirmed: A total of 10 vacancies across 8 posts are open; the application deadline is extended to November 2, 2026 (04:00 PM); age limits are 18 to 42 years with state-defined relaxations.
  • Unknown: Exact dates for written examinations, computer skill tests, and final merit list publication schedules have not been specified in the immediate update notice.

Readers should independently verify all criteria, check fee structures, and access direct application portals by reviewing the official announcement directly on the FreeJobAlert SKAU Recruitment 2026 Source Page.
